yum-china.name: Yum China
yum-china.description: Yum China Holdings, Inc. is a Chinese Fortune 500 fast-food restaurant company based in Shanghai, China. It operates 18,737 restaurants worldwide and was spun off from Yum! Brands in 2016. Yum China has a workforce of 290,000 employees and maintains an office in Plano, Texas for SEC filings.

yum-brands.name: Yum! Brands
yum-brands.description: Yum! Brands, Inc. is an American multinational fast food corporation based in Louisville, Kentucky. It operates KFC, Taco Bell, Habit Burger & Grill, and several technology companies. It is the world's second largest fast food restaurant chain by gross revenues as of 2024.

yamaha-motor-company.name: Yamaha Motor Company
yamaha-motor-company.description: Yamaha Motor Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational mobility manufacturer founded in 1955. It produces a wide range of motorized products including motorcycles, motorboats, outboard motors, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

yanzhou-coal-mining-company.name: Yanzhou Coal Mining Company
yanzhou-coal-mining-company.description: Yankuang Energy Group Company Limited, formerly Yanzhou Coal Mining Company Limited, is a Chinese energy company engaged in coal and potash mining, chemical production, power generation, and logistics. It is majority-owned by Shandong Energy Group.

yandex.name: Yandex
yandex.description: Yandex LLC is a Russian technology company offering internet-related products and services such as a web browser, search engine, cloud computing, and ridesharing. Yandex Search holds the largest market share in Russia, and Yandex Taxi is the largest ridesharing company there.

yamaha.name: Yamaha
yamaha.description: Yamaha Corporation is a Japanese multinational company that manufactures musical instruments and audio equipment.

yaskawa-electric-corporation.name: Yaskawa Electric Corporation
yaskawa-electric-corporation.description: Yaskawa Electric Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer specializing in servos, motion controllers, AC motor drives, switches, and industrial robots. Their Motoman robots are used in various industrial automation tasks such as welding and packaging.

yit.name: YIT
yit.description: YIT Oyj is the largest Finnish construction company headquartered in Helsinki. It develops and builds apartments, business premises, infrastructure, and operates in eight countries across Europe.

yelp.name: Yelp
yelp.description: Yelp Inc. is an American company that develops the Yelp.com website and mobile app, which publish crowd-sourced reviews about businesses. It also operates a table reservation service called Yelp Guest Manager. The company is headquartered in San Francisco.

yg-entertainment.name: YG Entertainment
yg-entertainment.description: YG Entertainment Inc. is a South Korean multinational entertainment agency established in 1996 by Yang Hyun-suk. It operates as a record label, talent agency, music production company, event management and concert production company, and music publishing house. The company also had various subsidiary ventures under YG Plus, though many were discontinued due to lack of profitability.

yunnan-copper.name: Yunnan Copper
yunnan-copper.description: Yunnan Copper Company Limited is the third largest copper producer in China. Established in 1958, it is based in Kunming, Yunnan, and operates in the mining industry.

youngor-group.name: Youngor Group
youngor-group.description: Youngor Group Company Limited is a public textiles and clothing company based in Ningbo, Zhejiang, China. It designs, manufactures, and sells men's clothing under the Youngor brand and was established in 1993.

yantian-international-container-terminal.name: Yantian International Container Terminals
yantian-international-container-terminal.description: Yantian International Container Terminal is a deep water port located in Shenzhen, Guangdong, China. It specializes in handling containers from feeder vessels to very large container ships.

yutaka-giken.name: Yutaka Giken
yutaka-giken.description: Yutaka Giken Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational automotive components manufacturer headquartered in Hamamatsu, Shizuoka. It specializes in torque converters, catalytic converters, exhaust systems, and brake systems, with multiple facilities in Japan and overseas. The company operates in the automotive industry.

yahoo-japan.name: Yahoo Japan
yahoo-japan.description: Yahoo! Japan is a Japanese web portal and was the most-visited website in Japan in October 2018. It is also ranked among the top 50 websites worldwide. The company operates primarily in Japan.

yili-group.name: Yili Group
yili-group.description: Yili Group is a Chinese dairy products producer headquartered in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia. It manufactures various milk products including ice cream and powdered milk under multiple brands and is partly state-owned by the government of Hohhot.

yokohama-rubber-company.name: Yokohama Rubber Company
yokohama-rubber-company.description: The Yokohama Rubber Company is a Japanese manufacturing company based in Hiratsuka, Japan. Founded in 1917 as a joint venture, it produces tires, rims, and golf equipment. The company expanded to the United States in 1969 as Yokohama Tire Corporation.

youku.name: Youku
youku.description: Youku Tudou Inc., doing business as Youku, is a subscription video on-demand streaming service and former video sharing website based in Beijing, China. It operates as a subsidiary of Alibaba Group Holding Limited.

yakult-honsha.name: Yakult Honsha
yakult-honsha.description: Yakult Honsha Company, Limited is a Japanese multinational corporation that produces Yakult, a probiotic beverage using lactic acid bacteria discovered in the 1920s. The company also owns the Tokyo Yakult Swallows baseball team and operates in India through a joint venture with Danone.

yoozoo-games.name: Yoozoo Games
yoozoo-games.description: Yoozoo Games is a video game developer and publisher founded in 2009 by Lin Qi. It creates browser and mobile MMORPG games and operates in Asia, Europe, and North America. The company was listed on the Shenzhen stock exchange in 2014.

yogaworks.name: YogaWorks
yogaworks.description: YogaWorks is a subsidiary of GoDigital Media Group based in the United States. It offers yoga therapy classes via streaming media and provides yoga teacher training. The company operates in the consumer goods and retail sector.

yokogawa-electric.name: Yokogawa Electric
yokogawa-electric.description: Yokogawa Electric Corporation is a Japanese multinational electrical engineering and software company. Its business focuses on measurement, control, and information technologies.

yuehua-entertainment.name: Yuehua Entertainment
yuehua-entertainment.description: Yuehua Entertainment is a privately held Chinese multinational entertainment group and talent agency based in Beijing. Founded in 2009, it is involved in television and movie production, artist management, music production, and entertainment marketing. It has partnered with South Korean entertainment companies.

yuke-s.name: Yuke's
yuke-s.description: Yuke's Co. Ltd. is a Japanese video game developer based in Osaka, established in 1993 by Yukinori Taniguchi. The company is known for developing the WWE video game series until 2018.

yes-bank.name: Yes Bank
yes-bank.description: Yes Bank is an Indian private sector bank headquartered in Mumbai. Founded in 2004 by Rana Kapoor and Ashok Kapur, it serves both retail and corporate customers with a network spanning 300 districts in India, including 1,300 branches and over 1,350 ATMs.

yeti.name: YETI
yeti.description: YETI Holdings, Inc. is an American company headquartered in Austin, Texas, specializing in outdoor recreation products. Its product range includes ice chests, vacuum-insulated stainless-steel drinkware, soft coolers, dry bags, and related accessories.

yutong.name: Yutong
yutong.description: Yutong is a Chinese manufacturer of commercial vehicles, especially electric buses, headquartered in Zhengzhou, Henan. It is the world's largest bus and coach manufacturer by volume and leads in new energy bus production.

ypsomed-holding.name: Ypsomed Holding
ypsomed-holding.description: Ypsomed Holding Inc. is a Swiss multinational medical technology company headquartered in Burgdorf, Switzerland. Founded in 2003 after the break up of Disetronic Group, it specializes in injection and infusion systems for self-medication, focusing on diabetes care and biotechnology.

yamazaki-baking.name: Yamazaki Baking
yamazaki-baking.description: Yamazaki Baking Company, Ltd. is a Japanese food company established in 1948. It is the world's largest bread-baking corporation, producing bread, bakery products, and confectionery. The company remains controlled by the founding Iijima family, now led by the third generation.

yanbu-national-petrochemical-company.name: Yanbu National Petrochemical Company
yanbu-national-petrochemical-company.description: Yanbu National Petrochemical Company (Yansab) is a Saudi Arabian petrochemical complex affiliated with SABIC. It is the largest SABIC petrochemical complex with an annual capacity exceeding 4 million metric tons of various petrochemical products.

yageo.name: YAGEO
yageo.description: YAGEO Corporation is a Taiwanese electronic component manufacturer founded in 1977 by Pierre Chen. The company specializes in passive devices such as resistors, capacitors, and inductors and was the third largest passive component manufacturer globally as of January 2020.

yuyuan-tourist-mart.name: Yuyuan Tourist Mart
yuyuan-tourist-mart.description: Shanghai Yuyuan Tourist Mart Co., Ltd. is the largest retailing conglomerate in China. The company operates in the retail sector and is based in China.

yield10-bioscience.name: Yield10 Bioscience
yield10-bioscience.description: Yield10 Bioscience is a U.S. company developing new technologies aimed at improving crop yield to enhance global food security. Its focus is on agricultural innovation.

yue-yuen-industrial-holdings.name: Yue Yuen Industrial Holdings
yue-yuen-industrial-holdings.description: Yue Yuen Industrial (Holdings) Limited is a Taiwanese footwear manufacturer headquartered in Hong Kong. It is the largest branded athletic and casual footwear manufacturer globally and serves as an OEM and ODM for major international brands like Nike, Adidas, and Puma.

yuexiu-property.name: Yuexiu Property
yuexiu-property.description: Yuexiu Property Company Limited is a property developer based in Guangdong, China. It is majorly owned by Guangzhou Yuexiu Holdings Limited, the investment corporation of the Guangzhou Government in Hong Kong. The company focuses on real estate development.

ynk-korea.name: YNK Korea
ynk-korea.description: YNK Korea Inc. is a South Korean online game publisher and developer founded in 1998 with its head office in Seoul. Initially focused on game marketing and character licensing for Blizzard Entertainment, it later shifted to online game content publishing.

yap-ve-kredi-bankas.name: Yapı ve Kredi Bankası
yap-ve-kredi-bankas.description: Yapı Kredi is one of the first nationwide commercial banks in Turkey, established in 1944. It is the fourth largest private bank in Turkey by asset size and offers a range of financial services including loans, credit cards, leasing, and insurance through a network of 835 branches.

yatai-group.name: Yatai Group
yatai-group.description: Jilin Yatai Group Company Limited is a private conglomerate based in Changchun, Jilin, China. Founded in 1993 and listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 1995, its core businesses include property development, cement manufacturing, and securities, with additional activities in coal mining, pharmaceuticals, and trading.

yext.name: Yext
yext.description: Yext is a New York-based enterprise marketing platform that helps brands deliver consistent and accurate information digitally from one central platform. Its platform is organized around the Knowledge Graph, a structured, machine-readable repository of brand data.

youku-tudou.name: Youku Tudou
youku-tudou.description: Youku Tudou Inc., known as Youku, is a subscription video on-demand streaming television service based in Beijing, China. It was formerly a video sharing website and now operates as a subsidiary of Alibaba Group Holding Limited. The company is part of the media and entertainment industry.

yume.name: YuMe
yume.description: YuMe is a data analysis platform for television advertising founded in 2004 by Jayant Kadambi and Ayyappan Sankaran. The company was acquired by advertising technology firm RhythmOne plc in February 2018. YuMe operates in the AI and software sector.

yunnan-baiyao-group.name: Yunnan Baiyao Group
yunnan-baiyao-group.description: Yunnan Baiyao Group Co., Ltd is a Chinese pharmaceutical company engaged in developing, manufacturing, and wholesaling pharmaceutical products. It also operates retail pharmaceutical sales. The company is based in China and works within the pharmaceutical industry.

yunnan-tin-company-limited.name: Yunnan Tin Company Limited
yunnan-tin-company-limited.description: Yunnan Tin Group (Holding) Company Limited is the largest tin producer and exporter in China and worldwide. Headquartered in Kunming, Yunnan, it produces, processes, and exports tin metal and related chemicals. The company was established in 1883 by the Qing Dynasty government.

yurun-group.name: Yurun Group
yurun-group.description: Yurun Group Limited is the largest meat supplier in mainland China, headquartered in Nanjing, Jiangsu. It operates in chilled, frozen, and processed meat sectors under brand names like Yurun, Furun, Wangrun, and Popular Meat Packing. The company is part of the agriculture and food industry.

yamana-gold.name: Yamana Gold
yamana-gold.description: Yamana Gold Inc. was a Canadian mining company headquartered in Toronto that owned and operated gold, silver, and copper mines in Canada, Chile, Brazil, and Argentina. Founded in 1994, it became a gold producer after a 2003 restructuring and merged with several other mining companies. Yamana was acquired by Pan American Silver in March 2023.

ytl-corporation.name: YTL Corporation
ytl-corporation.description: YTL Corporation is a Malaysian multinational company focused on infrastructure, including power generation, water, and sewerage services. Founded in 1955, it is listed on multiple stock exchanges including Bursa Malaysia and the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

yingli.name: Yingli
yingli.description: Yingli Green Energy Holding Company Limited, also known as Yingli Solar, is a solar panel manufacturer. It covers the photovoltaic value chain from ingot casting and wafering through solar cell production and solar panel assembly. The company is based in China.

yg-plus.name: YG Plus
yg-plus.description: YG Plus Inc. is a South Korean publicly traded media and advertising company acquired by YG Entertainment in 2014. It entered the music distribution industry in 2019 and also produces and licenses merchandise related to music artists.

yellow-pages-limited.name: Yellow Pages Limited
yellow-pages-limited.description: Yellow Pages Limited is a Canadian company that publishes directories and operates internet services including YellowPages.ca and Canada411.ca. It reaches approximately 9 million unique visitors monthly and has mobile applications downloaded more than 3 million times. The company focuses on local search and directory services in Canada.

yakovlev-corporation.name: Yakovlev Corporation
yakovlev-corporation.description: The JSC Yakovlev Corporation is a Russian aircraft manufacturer headquartered in Moscow. Founded in 1932 as the Irkutsk Aviation Plant, it manufactures the Sukhoi Su-30 family of interceptor and ground-attack aircraft. It was formerly known as Irkut Corporation.

younkers.name: Younkers
younkers.description: Younkers Inc. is an American online retailer and former department store chain founded in 1856 in Keokuk, Iowa. It expanded throughout Iowa and neighboring states over more than 150 years and was known for acquiring several rivals. The company transitioned ownership out of state in the late 1990s and closed its Des Moines headquarters by 2003.

yacimientos-carboniferos-rio-turbio.name: Yacimientos Carboníferos Río Turbio
yacimientos-carboniferos-rio-turbio.description: Yacimientos Carboníferos Río Turbio is an Argentine coal mining company created in 1994 to replace Yacimientos Carboníferos Fiscales. It extracts, ships, and sells coal from the Rio Turbio basin and is the only coal mine in Argentina. It is located in the southwestern extreme of the country.

ypfb.name: YPFB
ypfb.description: Yacimientos Petrolíferos Fiscales Bolivianos (YPFB) is a Bolivian state-owned enterprise focused on oil and natural gas exploration, refining, distribution, and commercialization. Created in 1936, it is one of the biggest corporations in Bolivia.
